description:
"If you don't kiss me now... I die."

Once you look at them, you can't look away from their seductive eyes. A kiss so sweet your lips melt the moment you touch it and a strong sensation as if her whole body IQ was revving up. "What... you?" One day he appeared in front of her, "I need your lips... Just a kiss".

A sensual man who takes a hot sensuality through his red lips.
